notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Rith's Attendant with haste.
Activate a Rith's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
When the Rith's Attendant token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining Rith's Attendant token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Rith's Attendant tokens and/or target any other creature.
